titleText: Refuse application for reservoir at Siġġiewi archaeological site, NGOs urge PA
mainText: From Times of Malta: Refuse application for reservoir at Siġġiewi archaeological site, NGOs urge PA. NGOs say the plan would permanently alter one of Malta’s most archaeologically sensitive rural landscapes

titleText: Casa defeats far-right challenge to the ESF, EPP says
mainText: From The Malta Independent: Casa defeats far-right challenge to the ESF, EPP says. Members of the European Parliament today voted overwhelmingly in favour of the negotiating mandate secured by MEP David Casa for the post-2027 European Social Fund (ESF), decisively defeating a far-right objection to the text, the EPP said Wednesday.

titleText: AI rife among students but institutions struggle to keep pace, surveys show
mainText: From Times of Malta: AI rife among students but institutions struggle to keep pace, surveys show. MFHEA surveys reveal gaps in staff training and institutional policies

titleText: PN calls for greater investment in prevention and support services to combat violence against women
mainText: From The Malta Independent: PN calls for greater investment in prevention and support services to combat violence against women. The Nationalist Party has called for greater investment in the prevention of gender-based violence, education grounded in respect and equality, and stronger support services for victims, while stressing the need to better address emerging forms of abuse, particularly digital violence.

titleText: Another mobile phone discovered in prison cell during night raid
mainText: From MaltaToday: Another mobile phone discovered in prison cell during night raid. Another mobile phone has been found in an inmate’s cell in the Corradino Correctional Facility (CCF). In a Facebook post on Tuesday night, Home Affairs Minister Glenn Bedingfield said “another phone” was found during a raid in a prison cell.
